discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: Topological insulators are one of the most widely tipped open discoveries in condensed matter physics. Kane and Mele's Z2 theory of the quantum spin Hall state (2005) and Molenkamp's experimental confirmation in HgTe quantum wells (2007) are foundational, very highly cited, and already honored with the Breakthrough, Dirac and Buckley prizes. Shoucheng Zhang's death leaves a clean trio of three.
